title: Design and permit.
officialText:
No chute shall be installed until a permit has been issued by the commissioner on the basis of
drawings prepared by a registered design professional.
Exception: Design and permit is not required for a chute that is:
1. Installed on the exterior of a building or structure at a height of 40 feet (12 192 mm) or less in height above the
level of the adjoining ground;
2. Has been designed by a manufacturer and is installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s design; and
3. Does not attach to or impart a load on a scaffold.
